title: An incident timeline exposes decision delay
method: Synthetic timeline from 10:00 to 10:40: 6+8+18+8=40 minutes. Boundaries must be recorded consistently; one exercise cannot predict all incident recovery times.
alt: An incident timeline exposes decision delay: Detection 6 minutes, Diagnosis 8 minutes, Authorization 18 minutes, Action and validation 8 minutes. Illustrative inputs.
